All 12 active tests pass.

Green Phase Complete:

**Implementation**: Added a single entry `moonstone: 25` to `BASE_PREMIUM_BY_ITEM_TYPE` in `/home/experimenter/experiments/runs/2026-07-26_00-13-47_claim-office-example-mapping_v4-exact-subagents_opus-5-no-thinking-3/src/claim-office.ts`.

**Result**: All tests now pass (12 passing, 36 todo).

**Approach**: This is minimal. The NaN came solely from the unknown `moonstone` type resolving to `undefined` in the lookup table. The existing `isComponentBlock` guard already returns `false` for this case (three items, but `items.every(item => item.type === items[0].type)` fails), so no change was needed to the block logic — 25 + 25 + 25 = 75 base, + 7.5 surcharge + 5 fee = 87.5, ceiling 88. One data line, no new logic, no handling for the upcoming "two separate blocks" test.

Proceeding to Refactor phase.
